regulatory compliance.

continued commitment to retaining, rewarding and nurturing top talent, recognizing that its 
people remain the foundation of company's long-term growth and innovation. Our continued 
focus on delivery excellence enabled us to expand EBITDA margin by 70 basis points 
sequentially despite the impact of the annual wage revision.

across customers and in all industry verticals. In terms of regions, US and India did very well 
for us, while Europe was soft with the predominance of automotive revenues from that region.

emerging from our clients' priorities around innovation, digital engineering, AI adoption and 
product modernization.
